chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Yasār narrated that he heard someone asking al-Riḍā عليه السلام:

About a man who prayed beside another man and stood on his left side, while not knowing what he should do if he realized that during the salat (prayer). He said: "He should move him to his right side."
ai.seo_question: What should be done if a person realizes during salat (prayer) that he is standing on the left side of another man?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the positioning of two men in salat (prayer), specifically when one stands on the left side of the other. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام instructs that he should be moved to the right side, indicating the proper arrangement during congregational prayer.
